Add BTS The 5th Album 'ARIRANG' (Deluxe Vinyl - Color Ver.) to cart Add to cart Ships on: April 3, 2026 Global pop superstars BTS are releasing a highly anticipated 5th album - the first group release in three years and nine months - now available for the Deluxe Vinyl featuring a new unreleased bonus track. Available in 'Deluxe Vinyl - Color Ver.', contents include: 12" Vinyl, Exclusive Gatefold Outer Sleeve, Inner Sleeve, Photo Book (20 pages), Turntable Slipmat (1ea), Lyric Paper (1ea), Poster (1ea), Postcard (1ea), Photo Card Set (7ea 1set), and Photo Card Holder. Dimensions: 314 x 312 x 8 mm This vinyl is a Target exclusive and is also available for online purchase through the BTS Official Store and Weverse US. Limited to 4 per customer. US customers only.
